title: claude-neoize lessons file
description: A file of authored lessons loaded by scripts/load-lessons. Each lesson is a piece of knowledge anchored to the entity it concerns, so it is retrieved by relevance rather than read wholesale.

_source.description: Free-text note on what this file groups and where it came from. Ignored by the loader.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. The loader MERGEs on it, so changing it creates a new node.

title.description: One line, the claim the lesson makes.

body.description: The full lesson: the trap, the mechanism and the fix, in enough detail to act on without reading the code.

kind.description: rule = a standing instruction; gotcha = a trap and its fix; reference = a fact catalogue; convention = a project norm.

scope.description: universal = always applies; situational = applies when editing the anchored code or running the anchored operation.

confidence.description: measured = demonstrated with a control; observed = seen once; inferred = reasoned, not yet proven.

status.description: active = loaded normally; historical = loaded and kept as a postmortem; retired = a tombstone, the node is deleted and not loaded.

anchors.description: What this lesson is about. Topic and Operation are authored (created on demand). Any other type must name a node the collector produced (Symbol, File, or a project structural label), or the loader reports and skips it.

type.description: A node label: Topic, Operation, Symbol, File, or a project structural label.

id.description: The id of the node to anchor to.

provenance.description: Flattened onto the node as prov_* props, so a lesson's age is queryable.

date.description: ISO date the lesson was learned (absolute, never relative).

supersedes.description: Lesson ids this lesson replaces. Each becomes (this)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(old). A target not in the graph or this load pass is reported and skipped.
